description: Cicely moves through pregnancy, mortality, art, faith and a long winter while Joel and Maggie's attraction becomes harder to ignore. The town remains capable of turning a medical problem, a dream, a frozen mammoth or a bowling match into a philosophical crisis.

s05e01.description: Joel succumbs to a strange glacier-related illness, leaving healer Leonard to handle patients including sleep-flying Ed and a suddenly songless Shelly.

s05e02.description: Maggie falls into a mystery surrounding an antique shop, Maurice resists aging with characteristic force, and Joel discovers an unexpected link between Jewish and Native traditions.

s05e03.description: Maurice is immortalized in wax, Chris learns he may live far longer than expected, and the arrival of a dentist makes Cicely rethink a neglected necessity.

s05e04.description: Bernard's girlfriend cannot reliably tell him from Chris, forcing the half-brothers to confront the uncanny overlap in their identities and relationships.

s05e05.description: A teenager asks Maggie to be homecoming queen, an uncompromising tax agent audits Ruth-Anne, and Maurice negotiates a land deal across cultural lines.

s05e06.description: Joel's parents visit Cicely, where his mother embraces Alaska and his father becomes unexpectedly popular, leaving Joel feeling displaced in his own family.

s05e07.description: Ed organizes Cicely's first film festival while Leonard searches American popular culture for evidence of a shared white mythology.

s05e08.description: Ed's successful diagnosis brings romance and a crisis of confidence, while Holling's mockery of pregnancy gets him expelled from Shelly's childbirth class.

s05e09.description: A grisly local story about cannibalism disturbs Ed, Holling and Ruth-Anne, while Chris's attempt to qualify as a pilot becomes its own test of nerves.

s05e10.description: As Cicely waits for winter's first snow, Joel struggles with an elderly patient's certainty that death is near and Shelly fears a small lie has physical consequences.

s05e11.description: Maggie organizes Shelly's baby shower, a Hollywood agent takes interest in Ed's screenplay, and Chris experiments with his idea of an inner feminine self.

s05e12.description: The aurora causes residents to exchange dreams, pushing Holling toward therapy and intensifying the feud between Maurice and innkeepers Ron and Erick.

s05e13.description: A virtuoso violinist begs Maurice to let a priceless instrument be played, Maggie becomes terrified of dust mites, and Chris hits an artistic wall.

s05e14.description: Maurice's fireworks crew alarms conspiracy-minded Adam, a displaced ranger refuses to leave his post, and Ed survives being struck by lightning.

s05e15.description: Shelly reconsiders giving birth in Anchorage, Walt risks frostbite for Ruth-Anne, and Joel discovers he is annoyingly good at Marilyn's knitting workshop.

s05e16.description: Joel's first dinner party becomes a social disaster, Shelly reconnects with her Canadian identity, and Chris's new radio programming irritates his loyal listeners.

s05e17.description: Cabin fever and rampaging caribou hit Cicely as Joel and Maggie are snowbound together, Walt misuses seasonal-depression medication and Ruth-Anne studies Dante in Italian.

s05e18.description: Joel becomes obsessed with catching an enormous fish, while Ruth-Anne abruptly abandons routine and takes to the road on a motorcycle.

s05e19.description: Joel bonds with another physician, Maurice temporarily moves in with the Tambo-Vincoeurs after an explosion, and Chris becomes fascinated by a chain of deer-related coincidences.

s05e20.description: Shelly's faith falters before Miranda's baptism, while Ed seeks redemption after carelessly spreading private details about Ruth-Anne.

s05e21.description: Ron and Erick prepare to marry despite Maurice's outrage, while Maggie develops a strange physical reaction whenever she is near Joel.

s05e22.description: Wheelchair racers arrive for a major competition, Ed's old embodiment of low self-esteem returns, and Ted gets an uncomfortable lesson in wealth and class.

s05e23.description: Cicely's blood drive reveals someone who may share Ed's rare blood type, while the return of Maggie's former boyfriend threatens Joel's growing closeness with her.

s05e24.description: Cal leaves the asylum temporarily to help Maurice entertain Barbara, Chris discovers memory has idealized an old love, and Joel finds a frozen mammoth.
